webstudio.is is the official open-source website builder's site, title 'Webstudio — Advanced Open Source Website Builder'; Crunchbase confirms Seedcamp as an investor.

aazzur.com homepage matches company name exactly; Haatch's own news page confirms it led AAZZUR's funding round.
Triver's own blog (blog.triver.com) confirms triver.com as the root domain; Silicon Canals confirms Stride.VC-led funding for Triver.
inntelo.com is the official site, but the brand is 'Inntelo AI' rather than bare 'Inntelo', a partial name match; Haatch's own post confirms its investment.
